title: BlindMRI: Stress Modeling with Generative Models & LLMs
summary: BlindMRI is a modular pipeline for simulating and detecting stress in patients undergoing MRI scans, combining physiological/demographic data, LLM-based validation, and conditional GAN data generation across baseline, environmental, and fine-tuned modeling stages. The project vendors the ctgan package (with its rdt and copulas dependencies) in-tree to drive its cGAN-based synthetic data generation stage.
evidence: blindMRI_baseline/venv/Lib/site-packages/ctgan/__init__.py imports CTGAN/TVAE; README describes 'cGAN-based data generation' as core pipeline stage
